about: Possible finding: Ordine was supplied as needed for pain and only senna was supplied, but the family cannot establish how long the child took morphine.
The parent confirms postoperative pain and doses spanning 84 hours for the as-needed morphine course, with senna as the only laxative supplied.
The uncovered March morphine course ended at exactly 48 hours, and lactulose covered the separate four-day course in September.
